requirement:
The table of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.table` MUST group
its listed files by their directory hierarchy. Each non-root directory
containing a listed file, directly or through descendants, MUST have a group.
Each group MUST be independently expandable and collapsible.

A collapsed group MUST show its workspace-relative path and the summaries
required by {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.minimum` and
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.minimum.statuses`, while
hiding its file rows and descendant groups.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation in `requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.directories`. I did not request implementation source or read the test helpers (`directory_summary`, `map_html`, `file_card`). I took their names to mean what they say. - **Grouping by directory hierarchy.** `directory_tables_preserve_rows_inside_independent_initially_closed_controls` walks the HTML tags with a stack of open `
` elements. It asserts the stack at each file row: - `root.rs` has no parent group. - `src/a.rs` sits under `src`. - `src/nested/b.rs` and `src/nested/c.rs` sit under `src` and then `src/nested`. - The stack ends empty, and every listed file has exactly one row. - **A group for every non-root directory with a listed file, directly or through descendants.** - `directories_with_only_descendant_files_keep_distinct_full_path_controls` uses `a/shared/deep/one.rs` and `b/shared/two.rs`. It asserts exactly five groups (`a`, `a/shared`, `a/shared/deep`, `b`, `b/shared`), so the intermediate directories that hold no file directly still get groups. It also shows the two `shared` directories stay distinct by full path. - `combined_directory_minimum_includes_hidden_passing_files` asserts groups for `src`, `src/nested` and `src/nested/deep` in the combined overview. The root file `code.rs` is asserted to sit outside any directory control. - **Each group independently expandable and collapsible.** - Each group is its own native `
` element with a distinct `data-directory`. - The tests assert that every group starts closed with no `open` attribute and that the page has no `` of `src` and `src/nested` contains `{directory}/`, the "Minimum measured file coverage:" label, `25.0%`, "1 not measured", no "unavailable", and the file counts. - The nesting walk shows rows and descendant groups are inside the `
` body, not the summary. - The combined test asserts the summary text is identical when the group is closed. That test also checks the "uncovered obligations" counts per directory. - **Cited minimum and statuses requirements.** The summary values are asserted for both the closed-by-default map and the open combined overview. Their own details (minimum computed before rounding, hidden files, unavailable counts) belong to the refining requirements `file_map.minimum` and `file_map.minimum.statuses`, which have their own tests. The tests carry `{test}` references to the subject. I found no unmarked relevant test and no obligation left without an assertion.

text: :::{req} index.file_map.directories
The table of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.table` MUST group
its listed files by their directory hierarchy. Each non-root directory
containing a listed file, directly or through descendants, MUST have a group.
Each group MUST be independently expandable and collapsible.
A collapsed group MUST show its workspace-relative path and the summaries
required by {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.minimum` and
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.minimum.statuses`, while
hiding its file rows and descendant groups.
:::{req} index.file_map.table
Each file coverage map MUST present its listed files in a compact table, with
one row per file and columns for its workspace-relative path and coverage
percentage or measurement status. Covered and instrumented line counts MUST
remain available in each measured file's row or expanded details.
The counts, statuses, and visual distinction of coverage levels MUST follow
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map`.
:::{req} index.file_map.minimum
Each directory group under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.directories` MUST display the
minimum measured file coverage percentage within its directory, including
descendant directories.
For the combined gaps overview, the minimum MUST consider all current
first-party Rust files represented by the map within that directory,
including files hidden because they have no unsatisfied obligations.
For a per-test map, the minimum MUST consider only listed files, following
the omission rule of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.test`.
The minimum MUST use the file coverage fractions of
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map` before rounding for display,
regardless of which groups are expanded. Its label MUST identify it as the
minimum measured file coverage. Not-measured and unavailable files MUST NOT
contribute a percentage. A group with no measured files MUST show no numerical
minimum.
:::{req} index.file_map.minimum.statuses
Each directory group under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map.directories` MUST separately
display the number of its listed files, including descendants, that are
not measured and the number that are unavailable whenever the corresponding
count is nonzero. These statuses MUST follow
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.file_map`. The counts MUST describe
only files listed by the map, regardless of which groups are expanded.
